summary.text: Sharonda Bell is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 118 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Clint Crowe.
Ballotpedia lists her as a prior Democratic nominee for the Georgia House in 2020, 2022 and 2024, none of which she won.

paragraphs.text: Sharonda Bell advanced from the Democratic primary for Georgia House of Representatives District 129 on June 9, 2020, and lost that November's general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 118 on May 24, 2022 and again on May 21, 2024, and lost the general election both times.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 118 on May 19, 2026.
